courses.title: Modern Full-Stack Web Development (MERN)
courses.description: Master MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js from the ground up. Build production-ready, full-stack web applications with modern patterns, clean architecture, REST APIs, and state management.

courses.title: Next.js 16 & React 19 Mastery
courses.description: Learn the Next.js App Router, React Server Components, Server Actions, Turbopack, and Tailwind CSS. The ultimate modern course for building blazing fast web apps.

courses.title: Python for Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
courses.description: Comprehensive introduction to Python programming, NumPy, Pandas, Data Visualization, and foundational Machine Learning models for modern developers.

courses.title: UI/UX Design Systems with Figma
courses.description: Design responsive web and mobile interfaces, master auto-layout, build reusable Figma design systems, and export production assets for developers.

lectures.title: Introduction to MERN Architecture
lectures.description: A complete high-level overview of the MERN stack, client-server communication, JSON data flow, and setting up the development environment.

lectures.title: Building RESTful APIs with Express & Mongoose
lectures.description: Design modular MVC controllers, configure Mongoose schemas and relationships, and structure reusable route handlers.

lectures.title: Authentication & JWT Security
lectures.description: Secure your backend using JSON Web Tokens (JWT), password hashing with bcrypt, and protect administrative endpoints.

lectures.title: Connecting React Frontend to Backend
lectures.description: Connecting the client to the server, handling asynchronous API requests, loading states, and error handling.

lectures.title: Next.js App Router Core Fundamentals
lectures.description: Understanding the directory layout conventions, dynamic routes, layout nesting, and page rendering in Next.js.

lectures.title: Server Components vs Client Components
lectures.description: Deep dive into React Server Components, hydration boundaries, and optimizing client-side bundle size.

lectures.title: Styling with Tailwind CSS 4
lectures.description: Modern CSS utility workflow with Tailwind CSS, custom design tokens, dark mode, and responsive layouts.

lectures.title: Python Fundamentals for Data Science
lectures.description: Core Python syntax, list comprehensions, data structures, and essential standard libraries.

lectures.title: Data Analysis with Pandas and NumPy
lectures.description: Reading CSV and JSON datasets, dataframe transformations, filtering, aggregations, and cleaning missing data.

lectures.title: Building Your First Machine Learning Model
lectures.description: Training, evaluating, and predicting using supervised regression and classification models with scikit-learn.

lectures.title: Design Principles & Visual Hierarchy
lectures.description: Typography scale, contrast ratios, whitespace, visual hierarchy, and creating accessible color palettes.

lectures.title: Mastering Auto-Layout & Component Variants
lectures.description: Building responsive components in Figma that stretch, wrap, and behave like real web elements.
